title: Reconstruct Itinerary
prompt: You are given a list of airline tickets where tickets[i] = [fromi, toi] represents the departure and arrival airports of one flight. Reconstruct the itinerary in order and return it. All of the tickets belong to a man who departs from JFK, thus the itinerary must begin with JFK. If multiple valid itineraries exist, return the smallest lexical order.
hints: Eulerian path: we must use every edge exactly once. Start at JFK. Use smallest lexical next at each step.
Build graph: from -> sorted list of destinations. DFS: pop from front when visiting. Add to result in post-order (reverse).
Use a multiset or min-heap per node, or sort and reverse so we can pop from back (lex order).
O(E log E) for sorting. Hierholzer algorithm.
